description: In-house AI coding assistant for BBF Code, powered by OpenCode Zen.
participant.description: Ask BBF AI Coder about your code, or let it work across your project.
command.models.description: Choose which model answers your requests
command.selectModel.title: Select Model
configuration.title: BBF AI Coder
configuration.enginePath: Absolute path to the OpenCode engine binary. Leave empty to use the copy bundled with BBF Code.
configuration.enginePort: Port for the local engine. `0` picks a free port automatically. The engine always binds to `127.0.0.1` and is never reachable from the network.
configuration.serviceUrl: Base URL of the BBF server that authorises AI Coder and proxies model traffic. Leave empty to use `https://bbf-server-code.onrender.com`. Must be HTTPS for any host other than this machine.
configuration.localAi.enabled: Whether models running on this machine are offered in the chat model picker, under **Local AI**. Requires a local Ollama runtime.
configuration.localAi.url: Root URL of the local Ollama runtime. Leave empty to use `http://localhost:11434`. Models it serves appear under **Local AI** and run entirely on this machine.
configuration.localAi.contextLength: Context window, in tokens, that local models are served with. Ollama serves a model with a 4K-token window by default, which is too small for coding tasks, so BBF Code registers a copy of each local model named `bbf/<model>` with this window and sends requests to the copy. A wider window needs more GPU memory; when it does not fit, Ollama runs part of the model on the CPU and answers more slowly.
configuration.deepReasoning: Whether BBF AI Coder lets the model think before answering. Off asks for a direct answer. Shown as the Deep Reasoning toggle in the chat input.
configuration.effort: How much reasoning effort BBF AI Coder asks the model for when Deep Reasoning is on. Shown as the Effort picker in the chat input.
configuration.effort.medium: The model's default balance of speed and depth.
configuration.effort.max: Maximum reasoning depth; slower, most thorough.
configuration.permissionMode: Who approves BBF AI Coder's file edits and commands. Shown as the mode picker in the chat input.
configuration.permissionMode.manual: Ask before every file edit, command and search.
configuration.permissionMode.auto: Let BBF AI Coder proceed on its own; every action is still recorded in the chat.
